'''Bola carbines''' were specially-handcrafted weapons that were originally made by members of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. A variant of the carbine was known as the '''Special Ops Bola carbine'''. They were in use after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Bola Carbines were known to be quieter than average blasters and always had a purple blaster bolt.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Bothan_bola_carbine.jpg|left|thumb|A Bothan with a bola carbine.]]
The Bola carbine first appeared in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massive Multiplayer Online Game|Massively Multiplayer Online Game]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] produced by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment. In the game, it could be found randomly as loot on enemies that a player killed. The weapon later received a card in the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Trading Card Game]], a virtual trading card game.
